name: Melting Pot Multi-Agent Evaluation Suite
description: A suite of multi-agent environments designed to evaluate cooperation, competition, communication, and social dilemmas in reinforcement learning settings.
evaluation_method: Average episodic return across a suite of procedurally defined multi-agent tasks, often aggregated over multiple seeds and scenarios
typical_sota_score: Highly environment- and population-dependent; strong agents can solve some tasks but not all, so aggregate scores vary widely
notes: Often used to study social behavior and emergent coordination. Results depend heavily on partner policies, training population, and scenario mix.
